IRDAI Proposes Public Insurance Registry for Transparency

The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) has proposed the creation of a Public Insurance Registry. This registry aims to enhance transparency and facilitate data sharing within the insurance sector. The proposal outlines what data will be linked and specifies who will have access to this information. The initiative is intended to streamline processes and improve the overall functioning of the insurance market.
